notes.subject: שנא/אשנא
notes.rationale: Go boela ga lefoko la go hloya le tee gomme gape — bao ba go hloileng, ke ba hloile; seo se laela botho bja lentšu leo ka Sepedi se phologa.

notes.subject: אתקוטט
notes.rationale: Letshwao le bolela go kgaola — diphetho tše fapaneng: 'go hloile ka go hlwa' (KJV) kgatlhanong le 'go lwantša le bona' (JPS); ka Sepedi ke 'go iphitša'.

translation: A ga ke ba hloile, Yahwe, bao ba go hloileng? Gomme le bao ba go tsuago mahlong, ke iphitše ka go ba hloya.

tokens.gloss: gomme le bao ba go tsuago mahlong
